typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BEGIN_DT as timestamp (),
	EmailMessage as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	END_DT as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileName_Prefix as string (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	MarketName as string (),
	OutputPath as string (),
	Rept_Begin_Day as integer (),
	RowCount_Members as integer (),
	Run_Type as string (),
	SendToMindoulaOutbound as string ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @GRGR_CK VARCHAR(10) = ?   	SELECT ResultSet = CAST(CONCAT(UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,\'|\',LAST_NAME,\'|\',FIRST_NAME,\'|\',MIDDLE_INIT,\'|\',DOB,\'|\',GENDER,\'|\',RACE_ETHNICITY,\'|\',PRIMARY_LANGUAGE,\'|\',MARITAL_STATUS,\'|\', 				   RESIDENT_ADDRESS,\'|\',CITY,\'|\',STATE,\'|\',ZIP_CODE,\'|\',COUNTY,\'|\',PHONE_NUMBER,\'|\',EMAIL_ADDRESS,\'|\',MEDICARE_ID,\'|\',MEDICAID_ID,\'|\',TYPE_OF_INSURANCE_PLAN,\'|\', 				   CURRENT_ASSIGNED_PCP_NPI,\'|\',CURRENT_ASSIGNED_PCP_NAME,\'|\',CURRENT_ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_NAME,\'|\',FAMILY_LINK_ID) 	AS VARCHAR(MAX)	)		   FROM EXTRACT.MINDOULA_STAGE_MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY WHERE (GRGR_CK = @GRGR_CK OR ROW_INDICATOR = \'HEADER\') GROUP BY UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,LAST_NAME,FIRST_NAME,MIDDLE_INIT,DOB,GENDER,RACE_ETHNICITY,PRIMARY_LANGUAGE,MARITAL_STATUS,RESIDENT_ADDRESS,CITY,STATE,ZIP_CODE,COUNTY,PHONE_NUMBER, 		 EMAIL_ADDRESS,MEDICARE_ID,MEDICAID_ID,TYPE_OF_INSURANCE_PLAN,CURRENT_ASSIGNED_PCP_NPI,CURRENT_ASSIGNED_PCP_NAME,CURRENT_ASSIGNED_CASE_MANAGER_NAME,FAMILY_LINK_ID,ROW_INDICATOR ORDER BY ROW_INDICATOR DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetMemberData
GetMemberData sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> MemberFileOutbound
